description: Gate 7: distance_class of searches outside a plan (reroute / avoid_chip; team decision 2026-11-25). Fixed when the search starts from the valid remaining ETA on the current route: < 1800 s -> short; >= 1800 s, unknown or invalidated -> long; the latest plan's class is never inherited. Only the native watchdog (short 5 s / long 10 s from each start) applies; the comparison budget is for plans. Cases: remaining ETA 1799 s (29:59) -> r1 short (watchdog 1000 + 5000); 1800 s (30:00) -> r2 long (3000 + 10000); plan p1 is short (estimate 1799 s) but off-route invalidates the remaining ETA -> the reroute r3 is long. 'route_eta' steps stand in for the remaining ETA from map-matching (null = invalidated; TODO), 'request' steps for triggers not wired into dc_tick yet.
